description: Unit test script for port_symlink.py, testing symlink creation, reading, deletion, and directory traversal functions within the starboard.tools package.

classes.name: PortSymlinkTest
classes.description: Unit test case for testing symlink operations and directory traversal functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes temporary directories and files, creates symlinks for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up temporary directories after tests.

methods.name: testSanity
methods.description: Checks that temporary directories and inner directories exist.

methods.name: testReadSymlinkNormalPath
methods.description: Verifies reading a non-symlink directory returns None.

methods.name: testSymlinkPath
methods.description: Checks that a symlink points to the correct target directory.

methods.name: testRelativeSymlinkPath
methods.description: Tests creating and reading a relative symlink, ensuring the link contains '..'.

methods.name: testRmtreeRemovesLink
methods.description: Ensures Rmtree removes the symlink but not the target directory.

methods.name: testRmtreeRemovesBrokenLink
methods.description: Ensures Rmtree can remove a broken symlink.

methods.name: testRmtreeDoesNotFollowSymlinks
methods.description: Verifies Rmtree deletes the symlink without deleting the target file.

methods.name: _MakeDirs
methods.description: Creates directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: _PathTypeToString
methods.description: Returns 'link', 'dir', or 'file' based on the path type.

methods.name: _GetAllPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects all file and directory paths starting from a directory.

methods.name: _IsSamePath
methods.description: Checks if two paths refer to the same file/directory.
